name: @turboslide/render-worker
description: The render worker (SPEC 3.3 item 7, 11 Hosting; MILESTONES M2 item 6): a Node job queue over the turboslide CLI for render, sheet, export and verify jobs, reached over HTTP by the studio facade routes, packaged with Chrome for Testing, LibreOffice, poppler and the export fonts by docker/render-worker.Dockerfile. Chromium and LibreOffice run in child processes, never in the web app.
